scientific_scope: Retrospective screening; numerical bands are engineering choices, not validated population cutoffs or old experiment gates
reference: Prism Balance v0.2.0 (M67 B-c20), exact matched mode/opponents/seeds/seats required
input_contract: candidate/reference sha256, rules_sha256, observed_grid_sha256, observed_grid entries {opponent: exact weight/execution SHA256, seed, seat}, metrics_semantics, mode, opponent_fixture exact identities, seed_start/end, seats [0,1], games, missing_games=0. Verify full Cartesian grid and recompute digest excluding actor identity; range equality alone is insufficient.
metrics_semantics: own-Main-12-24-v1; first_big is first 4-5 printed VP purchase conditional mean plus coverage; early_low is own Main<=12 0-1VP purchases; redemption credits actual later purchases <=24 using pre-purchase discounts, cap3 per investment/cap24 per game
missing: undetermined/INSUFFICIENT; per-route missing lists and provisional_hits; unknown alternative routes prevent exclusive assignment; never zero-fill
confidence: No CONFIRMED_IN_SCOPE from this retrospective policy; future independent policy must prefreeze paired intervals, effect sizes and opponent consistency
percentiles: midrank=(count lower + 0.5 count equal)/count; per fixed comparison group, exploratory only; do not treat games as independent models
version_proposal: Fixed versions in prism-v020-model-registry.json; Beta v0.2.0 remains unassigned
